issues.on_page: Reclassifications column: Operation and maintenance of plant (67,000); State programs (7,588) + Federal programs (212,484) less Instruction 200,072 = net (20,000)
issues.issue: [fixed] The hidden 87,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund comes out of two function groups: 67,000 from O&M of plant (support services) and 20,000 from state/federal programs, which this extraction files under instruction (detail[60]-[64]). The single -87,000 contra is filed entirely under support services. As a result, detail instruction (2,945,235 + 220,072 = 3,165,307) is 20,000 above the statement's Instruction 3,145,307, and support services O&M (400,349 - 87,000) is 20,000 below the statement's 333,349. This should be two contra lines: -67,000 support services (O&M) and -20,000 instruction (state/federal programs).
